governingRule: Official government sites only. Each topic answers to whoever owns that topic: township questions to the township, license and placard questions to the NJ MVC, county road and park questions to Morris County. No blogs, news articles, forums or search snippets treated as fact. If no listed source covers a question, fall back to the Mayor's Action Center instead of answering from model memory.

notApproved.note: JCP&L is the electric utility for most of Parsippany and owns most streetlights, but it is NOT an approved source for this chatbot. Discussion only.
PSE&G serves some Parsippany addresses for gas/electric, but it is NOT an approved source for this chatbot. Discussion only.

Township recreation registration portal, linked from township materials. Used as a registration link in the recreation topic only; NOT a general approved source. Discussion only until Nick approves adding it.
Morris County Municipal Utilities Authority publishes Parsippany solid-waste details, but it is NOT on the approved tier list Nick specified. Discussion only until Nick approves adding it.

policy: Adding a source takes a deliberate admin edit and, in production, Clerk approval. The chatbot may only search, fetch and cite sources on this list.
ranking: For local facts, township sources outrank county sources, which outrank state sources.

sources.scope: Township government: departments, meetings, calendar, news, forms
Parsippany-Troy Hills School District, school questions only
Parsippany Library, library hours and programs only
County roads, county parks, elections, county services, Board of Taxation
NJ Motor Vehicle Commission: plates, disability placards, licenses
NJ court system: tickets and municipal court process, NJMCdirect
State programs that township pages point to
